असृज् (क्), m. the planet Mars;
N. of the 16th of the astrological Yogas, also called Siddhi, L.
a: असृज् — n. [न सृज्यते इतररागवत् संसृज्यते सहजत्वात् न-सृज्-क्विन् Tv.] 1 Blood. --2 The planet Mars. --3 Saffron. --m. N. of the 16th of the 27 Yogas; धनी कुरूपः कुमती दुरात्मा विदेशगामी रुधिरप्रकोपः . महाप्रलोभी पुरुषो बलीयानसृक्प्रसूतौ किल यस्य जंतोः ... Śabdak. --Comp. --करः [असृक् शोणितं करोति कृ-ट] the essence of the body; lymph, serum; (the process of रस turning into blood &c., is thus described by Suśr.: --रसाद्रक्तं ततो मांसं मांसान्मेदः प्रजायते . मेदसोस्थि ततो मज्जा मज्ज्नः शुक्रस्य संभवः). --दरः an irregular or excessive menstruation, mœnorrhagia. --दाहेः shedding blood. --धरा the skin. --धारा {1} a stream of blood. {2} the skin. --पः, --पाः ‘a blood-drinker’, a Rākṣasa. --पातः the falling of blood. (pl.) drops of blood. --पावन् a. Ved. drinking blood. --वहा a blood-vessel; pulse. --विमोक्षणं blood-letting, bleeding. --श्रा (स्रा) वः bleeding.

preritaM mUtraM meQraBagamArgeRa, purIzaM gudamArgeRa SarIrAdbahiryAti uktaYca “BUtraMhyupasTamArgeRa purIzaM gudamArgataH । apAnavAyunAkziptaM bahiryAti SarIrataH” । upasTaH SisnoBagaYca । rasastu samAnavAyunA preritoDamanImArgeRa SarIrAramBakasya rasasya sTAnaM hfdayaM gatvA tena sahamiSritoBavati UktaYca “rasastu hfdayaM yAti samAnamaruteritaH । sa tu vyAnena puvikziptaH sarvvAnDAtUn vivardDayet । kedArezu yaTA kulyAH zRanti viviDOzaDIH taTA kalevare DAtUn sarvAnbardDayate rasaH” rasastu tatra tatra triGA viBidyate । uktaM ca carake “sTUlA evaM malaBedEstatratatra triDA rasaH । svaMsTUle'MSaH paraM sUkzma stanmalo yAti tanmalam” । ayamarTaH sTUle'MSaH svaMyAti । yaTAsTitaM tizWati sUkzmastvaMSaHparaM dvitIyaM DAtuM yAtitanmalaH rasAdimalastanmalaM SarIrAramBakaM tattadDAtumalaM yAtItyarTaH yaTA lOkikAgninekzurasaH pacyate taTA SarIrAramBakasya rasasya agninAhArarasaH pacyate pacyamAnaH sa paYcAhorAtrAtsArdDadaRqamekaM ca yAvatprAktanarasaDAtAveva tizWate uktaYca suSrute “sa Kalu rasastrIRi trIRi kalAsahasrARi paYcadaSakalA ekEkasminDAtAveva tizWati” iti । atra kalAnAM viMSatiH muhUrttaH sa ca daRqadvayAtmakaH taTA ca BojaH “GAtO rasAdO majjAnte pratyekaM kramatorasaH । ahorAtrAtsvayaMpaYca sArdDaM daRqaM ca tizWati” । pratyekam ekasminnekasminnityarTaH tato yaTA pacyamAnAdikzurasAnmalonirgacCati । taTA pacyamAnAdAhArarasAnmalo nirgacCati saH kaPaH uktaYca suSrute “kaPapittamalAH Kezu prasvedonaKaroma ca netraviwcakzuzaH srehoDAtUnAM kramaSomalAH । KezumalaH karRRAdisrotomalaH । sa ca kaPaH prARAnilapreritoDamanImArgeRa SarIrAramBakaM kledanAKyaM kaPaM gatvA puzRAti । tataH sAraBUtasyAhArarasasya dvO BAgO BavataH sTUlaH sUkzmaSca tatra sUkzmoBAgaH SarIrAramBakaM rasaM pozayati sakalaSarIrADizWAnena vyAnavAyunA preritoDamanIBiH saYcaran pozaRasnehanajaWarAnalozmakftasantApanivAraRAdiBirguREH sakalaM puzRAti SarIram tataH sTUloBAgaH prARavAyunA preritoDamanImArgeRa SarIrAramBakasya raktasya sTAnaM gatvA yakftplIharUpaNgatvA tena saha miSrito Bavati । tataH prAktanaraktasTAgninA punaH pacyamAnaH paYcAhorAtrAtsArdDadaRqaYca yAvatprAktanaraktaGAtAveva tizwati tato yaTAgninA punaHpunaH pacyamAnAdikzuvikArAdvAraMvAraM malaM nirgacCati । taTA punaHpunaH pacyamAnA dAhArarasAtprativAraM malaM nirgacCati tatra raktAgninApacyamAnAnmalaM pittaM nirgacCati । tacca pittaM samAnavAyunA preritaM DamanImArgeRa SarIrAramBakaM pAcakAKyaM pittaM gatvA puzRAti । tataH sAraBUtasyAhArarasasya dvO BAgO BavataH । sTUlaH sUkzmaSca । tatra sUkzmoBAgoraYjakAKyena pittena raktIkftaH SarIrAramBakaM raktaM pozayan vyAnabAyunA prerito DamanIBiH saYcaran sakalaSarIragatAni ruDirARi puzRAti । tataH sTUloBAgo vyAnavAyunApreritoDamanIBiH SirABiSca SarIrAramBakARi mAMsAni yAti tato mAMsAgninA punaH pacyamAnaH paYcAhorAtrA tsArdDadaRqaMyAvanmAMsezveva tizWati tataH pacyamAnAttasmAnmalaM nirgacCati tadvyAnavAyunA kziptaM karRAvAgatya karRRa viqBavati tataH sAraBUtasya rasasya dvO BAgO BavataH sTUlaH sUkzmaSca tataH sUkzmoBAgo mAMsAni puzRAti tataH sTUloBAgovyAnavAyunA preritoDamanIBiH SarIrAramBakasya medasaHsTAnamudaraM yAti tatomedaso'gninA punaH pacyamAnaH paYcAhorAtrAtsAMrdDadaRqaYca yAvanmedasyeva tizWati tataH pacyamAnAttasmAnmalo nirgacCati prasvedarUpaH sa ca SItaH srotasyeva tizWati SarIrozRaRA taptaSca tadA vyAnavAyunA preritaH SirAmArge lomakUpeByo bahiryAti jihvAdantakakzAmeQrAdimalaYca medomalamityeke । tataH sAraBUtasya rasasya dvOBAgO BavataH sTUlaH sUkzmaSca tatra sUkzmoBAgo medaH puzRAti udare tizWan vyAnavAyunA preritaH srotomArgEH sUkzmAsTitAnyapi medAMsi puzRAti sTUloBAgovyAnavAyunA preritoDamanIBiH SirABiSca SarIrAramBakARyasTIni yAti tatosTyagninA punaH pacyamAnaH paYcAhorAtrAt sArdDadaRqaM ca yAvadasTizveva tizWati tataH pacyamAnAttasmAnmalo nirgacCati sa ca vyAnavAyunApreritaH SirABirmArgErAgatyANgulizu naKAHstanO lomAni Bavanti tataH sAraBUtasya rasasya dvO BAgO BavataH sTUlaH sUkzmaSca tatra sUkzmoBAgovyAnavAyunA preritaH srotomArgErmajjasTAnAni sTUlAsTyaByantarARi yAti tato majjAgninA punaH pacyamAnaH paYcAhorAtrAtsArdDadaRqaYca yAvanmajjanyevAvatizWati । tataH pacyamAnAt tasmAnmalaM nirgacCati । tacca vyAnavAyunA preritaM SirAmArgeneyanayorAgatya netraviw cakzusnehaSca Bavati tataHsAraBUtasya rasasya dvO BAgO BavataH sTUlaH sUkzmaSca । tatra sUkzkzoBAgomajjAnaM puzRAti tataH sTUloBAgovyAnavAyunA preritoDamanIBiH SirABiSca Sukrasya sTAnaM sakalaM SarIraM gatvA SarIrAramBakeRa SukreRa saha miSrito Bavati । tataH SukrasyAgninA punaH pacyate pacyamAne tasminmalaM nAsti sa hi sahasraDADmAtasuvarRavat । uktaYca “svAgniBiH pacyamAnezu malaH zawsu rasAdizu । na Sukre pacyamAne'pi hemanIvAkzaye malaH” । anyacca “svAgniBiH pacyamAnezu majjAntezu ramAdizu । zawsu DAtuzu jAyante malAni munayojaguH । yaTA sahasraDADmAte na malaM kilakAYcane । taTA rase muhuH pakve na malaM SukratAM gate” । tataH sAraBUtasya rasasya dvO BAgO BavataH । sTUlaHsUkzkzaSca tatra sUkzmasnehaBAgaH ojastasya lakzaRamAha । “ojaH sarvaSarIrasTaM snigDaMSItaM sTiraMsitam । somAtmakaM SarIrasya bala puzwikaraM matam” valaM cezWApAwavaM taTA ca । “cezWAsu pAwavaM yattu balantadaBiDIyate iti” yattu suSrute rasAdInAM SukrAntAnAM DAtUnAM yatparantejastat Kalvojastadeva balamiti tejastejodravaH” । atrAyamaBiprAyaH । yasmAdrasAdojo Bavati rasaH sarvaDAtusTAnagatatvAttadDAtuvanmanyata iti । sarvaDAtUnAM snehamojaHkzIre Gftamiva tadeva balamiti” tatkAryyakAraRayoraBedopacArAt aBedakaTanaM ca vikitsEkyArTam । “anyacca “guru SItaM mfdu snigDaM sAndraM svAdu sTiraMtaTAprasannaM picCalaM sUkzkzamojo daSaguRaM smftam” । carake tu “azwavindupramARantadIzadraktaM sapittakam । agnisomAtmakatvena dvirUpaM varRitaM tu tat” । vAgBawaSca “ojastu tejo DAtUnAM SukrAntAnAM paraM smftam । hfdayasTamapi vyApi dehasTiti nibanDanam । yasya pravfdDO dehasya tuzwipuzwibalodayAH । yannASe niyatonASo yasmiMstizWati jIvanam । nizpadyante yato BAvAviviDA dehasaMSrayAH । utsAhaH pratiBA cEva lAvaRyAM sukumAratA” । tataH sTUlaBAgo rasomAsena puMsAM SukraM strIRAM tvArttavaM SukraM ca Bavati । uktaYca suSrute “evaM mAsena rasaH SukrIBavati strIRAmArttavaM ca BavatIti ceti” cakArAt strIRAmapi SukraM Bavati । ataevoktaM suSrute । “yozito'pi sravatyeva SukraM puMsaH samAgame । tanna garBasya kiYci ttu karotIti na cintyate” garBasya SudDasya, vikftasya tu garBasya kAraRantadapi Bavati yata uktaM “yadA nAryAvupeyAtAM vfzasyantyO kaTaYcana । muYcantyO SukramanyonyamanasTistatra jAyate” iti । etena strIRAM saptamoDAturArtavaM Sukramazwama iti boDitam ASayADikyavat । “strIRAM garBopayogI syAdArttavaM sarvasammatam tAsAmapi balaM varRaM SukraM puzwiM karoti hi” । evaM rasaeva kedArakulyAnyAyena sarvAnDAtUn pUrayati mAsena navadaRqottareRa SukramArttavaYca Bavati iti sidDAntaH । evaM sati rasAdraktamiti maNgatameva tatomAMsantato raktotpatteranantaraMmAMsaM jAyate rasAdevetyarTaH mAMsAnmedaH prajAyate iti mAMsAdanantaraM medaH prajAyate rasAdevetyarTaH । medaso'sTi medaso'gre'sTi jAyate rasAdevetyarTaH । evaM tatomajjA majjYo'gre Sukrasya samBava ityarTaH । rasaHSarIre triDA saYca rati taTAcoktam । “rasaHSarIre SabdArcirjjalasantAnavat triDA । saMcaratyanurUpo'yaM nityameva hi dehinAm” । asyAyamaBiprAyaH puruzAstIkzRAgnayomaDyamAgnayomandAgnayaSca Bavanti tatra tIkzRAgnInAM rasaHSabdasantAnavacCIGraM saYcarati । maDyAmAgnInAmarcciHsantAnavanmaDyavegena saYcarati । mandAgnInAM jalasantAnavanmandaM saYcarati । tena mAsena rasaH SukraM Bavati yaduktaM tanmaDyamAgnInaDikftyoktaM dIptAgnInAM tu rasaH kiYcidUnena mAsena SukraM Bavati । mandAgnestu kiYcidaDikena mAseneti sidDAntaH” ।
